SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
David Ryan
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0110 | david.ryan@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Category data analyst at a building materials wholesaler with 22 branches, supporting product managers on lumber, roofing, insulation and seasonal lines since mid 2023. Before that, spent four years in sales support and reporting at the same company. Does most analysis in Excel, maintains a few Power BI reports and writes everyday SQL against the company warehouse.

EXPERIENCE
Category Data Analyst | Stonereach Builders Supply, Columbus, OH | Jul 2023 to Present
• Prepare the Excel workbooks behind quarterly category reviews for two product managers, combining sales, margin and inventory turns exported from the ERP and the warehouse.
• Maintain two Power BI reports on weekly branch sales that were built by a previous analyst, updating filters and visuals as product managers ask for changes.
• Write SQL against Snowflake for ad hoc questions on product and branch sales, mostly joins and grouped totals, and ask the BI team for help with more involved queries.
• Help with the seasonal buy for snow and ice melt by pulling three years of weekly branch sales into an Excel planning sheet for the product manager.
• Pulled branch level margin before and after a small contractor pricing change on fasteners, which the product manager used in a recommendation to keep it.
• Keep an Excel list of SKUs that landed in the wrong subcategory after the ERP migration and send weekly corrections to the item setup team.
• Join the monthly replenishment meeting and bring a short list of stockouts by branch for the team to discuss.
• Check vendor rebate accrual totals in Excel each quarter against what finance booked, and send differences to the accounting contact for follow-up.
• Put together a one page summary of insulation and roofing sales trends for the spring planning meeting, written for branch managers who rarely open the reports.
• Answer routine questions from branch staff about where to find sales numbers in the existing reports.

Sales Support Coordinator | Stonereach Builders Supply, Columbus, OH | Jun 2019 to Jun 2023
• Compiled weekly sales and gross margin reports by branch and sales rep in Excel for regional directors.
• Entered and checked contractor quotes, price overrides and special orders for six branches.
• Tracked framing lumber cost changes in 2020 and 2021 in an Excel sheet that branch managers used to update quotes.
• Pulled sales history by vendor for the annual line review, using ERP exports and pivot tables.
• Noticed a contractor loyalty rebate being paid on some returned goods and passed the examples to finance for review.
• Learned basic SQL in 2022 by taking over a few saved queries from the reporting team.
• Kept the branch contact list and rep territory file current after each reorganization.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2019

SKILLS
Spreadsheets: advanced Excel (pivot tables, INDEX MATCH, Power Query, conditional formatting)
Querying: SQL (Snowflake), joins, GROUP BY, basic subqueries
BI: Power BI (editing existing reports, basic visuals)
Building materials: category reviews, vendor line reviews, inventory turns, seasonal buy support, contractor pricing
Other tools: Epicor ERP, SharePoint

ADDITIONAL
• Volunteer materials coordinator for a Columbus home repair nonprofit, keeping the inventory spreadsheet for about 40 repair projects a year

ASSISTANT:
{"score": 85, "decision": "ADVANCE", "reason": "David brings five total years of relevant experience at a local building materials wholesaler, a BS in Statistics, and direct familiarity with Snowflake, Power BI, and industry domain data."}
